summary: 42yo owner of Garza Precision Machine. 5 CNC machines, AS9100 aerospace work. Air system is a 7-year-old 5HP piston compressor with moisture problems.

Owner of Midwest Air Power, an independent compressed-air distributor + service shop. Sells Kaishan rotary-screw compressors but has no dedicated dryer/filtration line — drop-ships treatment at thin margin. KSI distributor-recruitment target.
